content:
<!-- B"H
Boruch Hashem
Blessed is He

Malchus receives the image and the word, while Yesod carries their intent and Tiferes keeps them one; the Awtsmoos creates each instant anew, and Awtsmoos.com will release only what inspection, testing, and public proof have fully begun and done.
-->
# Final Pre-Code Plan

1. Inspect newest `origin/main`, production ancestry, and exact current Olam Create source.
2. Capture current 390x844 live DOM geometry and media/prompt body behavior.
3. Trace upload, assigned-media, replace/remove, repository, preview cache, draft, and generation transport end-to-end.
4. Trace current `/api/olam-h3` routes and browser API callers so UI work preserves every call contract.
5. Freeze an exact small whole-file touch list based on inspection.
6. Create a new sparse release worktree from latest `origin/main`; preserve unrelated shared-worktree state.
7. Write the complete media-first body implementation before tests.
8. Add focused body-first UX and image-update/payload regressions.
9. Run source/line/syntax/diff checks, deterministic suite, new media tests, and all existing Chrome suites.
10. Re-read every touched file, compare PLANNED vs ACTUAL, resolve DELTA.
11. Refresh `origin/main`; if parent changes outside targets, rebase safely and rerun final gate.
12. Commit only intended Olam paths; normal fast-forward push only.
13. Canonically deploy exact final SHA.
14. Verify public HTTP, mobile media/prompt flow, replacement persistence/payload behavior, existing regressions, production SHA/clean service.
15. Cleanup owned temporary worktrees/processes and write final release evidence.

NEXT_ACTION: inspect latest source/runtime and trace the media/prompt/API path before approving the touch list.
